title: Frigidaire Professional — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Frigidaire Professional.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Pro Performance, Frigidaire Price." Frigidaire Professional brings a commercial-grade look to the Electrolux value portfolio. Pro-style handles, PowerPlus convection, and smudge-proof stainless at a price point well below KitchenAid or Cafe. It is the entry into pro-style cooking for customers who love the look but cannot justify Wolf or Thermador budgets.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who want the pro-style kitchen look on a budget. Stepping up from base Frigidaire.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Frigidaire Professional:

• Pro-style look at mid-range pricing — heavy-duty handles, commercial aesthetic

• PowerPlus convection with third element for consistent baking

• Smudge-proof stainless across the line

• Total capacity leaders in the refrigerator lineup

• Entry point to pro-style kitchens — the look of Wolf at a fraction of the price
